newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi denies helping Zaire's Tutsi rebels.
newsitem.headline: Burundi denies helping Zaire's Tutsi rebels.

text.p: Burundi's military government summoned Zaire's charge d'affaires on Wednesday to protest against Kinshasa's allegations that Burundi was helping ethnic Tutsi rebels fight in eastern Zaire.
"The government of the Burundian Republic is deeply indignant about the accusations," a statement issued by the Burundian foreign ministry said.
Burundi's foreign ministry also met western diplomats to assure them it was not supporting ethnic Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels, a foreign ministry official said.

Zaire this week repeated allegations that Rwanda and Burundi's Tutsi-dominated armies were behind the warfare in eastern Zaire, arming and fighting alongside Banyamulenge rebels, accusations both countries have denied.
Diplomats argue Burundi's army is too deeply involved in its own civil war against Hutu rebels to be active in the Zaire conflict.
